setting: Kurukṣetra at dawn on the day of the cakravyūha; a low sun rakes across a field carved like dark basalt relief under a smoke-coloured sky
blocking: Seen from far above, as if by divine sight: the Kaurava host turns rank by rank into a great wheel around a still centre, chariots and banners carved in stone. Droṇa's chariot stands small at its head. No face resolves.
